bugs.error_message: Canva answered, but without a picture or a design BrandPilot could read. Check your Canva account before trying again. (canva_unreadable)
bugs.root_cause: Canva's MCP generate-image answered isError:false with structuredContent { status: "failed", failure: { code: "quota_exceeded" } } and _meta["com.canva/aiCreditQuotaError"] ("You have exceeded your credit quota."). callTool only treated isError:true as a failure, so the answer went on as a success with no design or picture and was labelled unreadable.
bugs.fix: failureOf(result) detects status "failed" / failure / the credit-quota meta even without isError; callTool throws canva_credits (402) with Canva's words and the reset date (quota_usage.resets_at). Generate-all already stops on credits.

bugs.error_message: Uncaught TypeError in assetPreview: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'v') — clicking Slide 2/5 in Campaign Studio did nothing
bugs.root_cause: Carousel slides 2..n have no caption field (inAssets only adds a field when its text is non-empty; the caption is only on slide 1). assetPreview and assetFile read a.fields.caption.v unconditionally, so rendering a later slide threw and the old screen stayed — the click did set S.ui.aid but the view never re-drew.
bugs.fix: Guard a.fields.caption in assetPreview (shows "The post caption is on slide 1") and in assetFile (caption.txt only when a caption exists).

bugs.error_message: Adding a website showed no change for ~25 s, then a page-chooser dialog popped over an already-switched results screen; 631 facts from 4 pages
bugs.root_cause: A.scan only set SRV.scanning (a disabled button label) and a 3 s toast while the server read the page and asked the AI to choose links; the chooser was a MODAL opened at the end while discovery had already re-rendered Home. Rule extraction turned every line under a heading of a website page into a fact (menus, buttons, price tables).
bugs.fix: readTrack step tracker with a live seconds ticker replaces the add box; page chooser inline on Home/Sources; website-only filters in extract (okWeb: nav labels, short/numeric lines, per-category caps).
